name: SMAD family member 2

function.text: SMAD2 encodes SMAD family member 2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in DNA-templated transcription and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to Loeys-Dietz syndrome 6 (autosomal dominant); congenital heart disease (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Colorectal Adenocarcinoma; Colon Adenocarcinoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
